ai_think_interval_lod_very_low: Sets how often NPCs update their decisions at the lowest AI detail level.
anim_resource_validate_on_load: Checks each animation group's channel list against its animations as they load.
audio_viewing_damage_decay_time: Sets how long the audio system's viewing damage value takes to return to zero.
audio_viewing_damage_hold_time: Sets how long the audio system holds the viewing damage value before reducing it.
citadel_death_ragdoll_duration: Sets how long a defeated hero's body stays visible. The body can remain after the death camera ends.
citadel_fibonnaci_sphere_trace_los_max: Caps the radius used for line-of-sight checks on large explosions and effects.
citadel_player_model_force_highest_lod: Always draws your hero model at its highest level of detail.
citadel_show_old_neutral_camp_icons: Uses the previous neutral camp symbols on the minimap.
citadel_zipline_render_mode: Selects what the zipline draws. Use 0 for the model, 1 for particles, or 2 for both.
cl_generate_postdataupdatepreserved: Runs the post-update callback for unchanged entities that are still potentially visible.
cl_particle_fallback_multiplier: Adjusts when high load causes the game to switch to less expensive particle effects.
cl_particle_newinit: Uses the optimized path to initialize particles.
con_enable: Lets players open the developer console.
csm_sst_pushback_distance: Sets the default pushback distance for sparse shadow tree cascades.
engine_allow_multiple_simulates_per_fram: Lets the client run extra simulation steps per frame to catch up when the frame rate drops.
fps_max_tools: Caps frames per second when tools mode is active and the game window is unfocused. This cap cannot exceed the normal fps_max limit. Use 0 to disable the extra cap.
lb_csm_override_bulb_radius: Sets a different bulb radius for cascaded shadow maps.
lb_csm_override_staticgeo_cascades_anima: Limits the static geometry cascade override to geometry without animated vertices.
lb_cull_offscreen_bounce_light_shadows: Skips shadow maps for offscreen dynamic bounce lights that indirect lighting will not sample.
lb_cull_onscreen_bounce_light_shadows: Skips shadow maps for dynamic bounce lights on screen when their shadows are unlikely to be visible.
lb_dynamic_shadow_resolution_base_cmp_sh: Uses the smaller of the dynamic shadow resolution and the barn light's shadow map size as the base resolution.
panorama_disable_descendant_filtering: Turns off filtering for descendant selectors in the Panorama interface.
panorama_script_cache_enabled: Caches Panorama scripts so they can be recompiled faster.
phys_highlight_expensive_objects_strengt: Sets how strongly the physics debug view highlights expensive objects.
r_bloom_tent_filter_radius: Controls the bloom upsampling filter radius in texels at that mip level. Use 0 for a fixed 2 × 2 box filter instead of the 3 × 3 tent filter.
r_citadel_disable_particle_lights: Turns off particle lighting by default. Individual particle renderers can override it.
r_citadel_distancefield_max_distance: Sets how far away distance-field effects are considered before the renderer culls them.
r_citadel_distancefield_occlusion_length: Sets how far the renderer checks for occlusion with distance fields.
r_citadel_distancefield_ray_origin_bias_: Sets the upper limit on the ray origin offset for distance-field rendering.
Sets the lower limit on the ray origin offset for distance-field rendering.
r_citadel_fsr_enable_mip_bias: Lets FSR use a negative mip bias to sample more detailed texture levels.
r_fullscreen_gamma: Changes gamma when the game uses fullscreen mode.
r_size_cull_threshold_fade: Sets how far above the screen-size cutoff objects start fading. Use 0 to turn off that fade.
r_texture_nonstreaming_load: Allows the game to load mip levels when it reads a texture header, which can reduce later disk reads and delays.
r_use_memory_budget_model: Estimates the GPU memory budget internally instead of asking the operating system.
r_vma_defrag_algorithm: Selects GPU memory defragmentation mode. Use 0 for fast, 1 for balanced, 2 for full, or 3 for extensive.
rtx_dynamic_blas: Lets ray tracing create acceleration structures for geometry animated by compute shader skinning.
rtx_dynamic_blas_caching: Reuses a dynamic ray tracing acceleration structure while its geometry stays unchanged.
rtx_force_default_hitgroup: Uses the default ray tracing hit shaders for all geometry, including geometry with specialized shaders.
rtx_texture_resolution: Sets which texture resolution ray tracing requests from the streamer.
sc_aggregate_gpu_culling: Lets the GPU discard aggregate meshes that do not need drawing.
sc_aggregate_render_mesh_shader: Draws aggregate geometry with mesh shaders when the GPU supports them.
sc_barnlight_enable_precomputed_vis: Lets barn lights use precomputed visibility. A map restart is required.
sc_instanced_mesh_enable: Allows the scene renderer to draw repeated copies of a mesh as instances.
sc_instanced_mesh_gpu_culling: Lets the GPU discard mesh instances that do not need drawing.
sc_instanced_mesh_gpu_density_culling: Lets the GPU reduce the number of mesh instances it draws based on density.
sc_instanced_mesh_shadows_batch_across_m: Allows the instanced mesh shader to group shadow work across materials by reflectivity.
scene_clientflex: Runs flex animation on the client.
shake_show: Lists the screen shakes currently playing.
snd_boxverb_simd: Uses SIMD instructions to process shoebox reverb.
snd_diffusor_simd: Uses SIMD instructions to process audio diffusion.
snd_steamaudio_enable_editor_profiling: Collects Tracy profile data while Hammer bakes Steam Audio.
snd_steamaudio_enable_occlusion_caching: Keeps the last occlusion result when Steam Audio cannot find a probe.
snd_steamaudio_enable_ordertruncated_amb: Allows Steam Audio to load HRTFs with a reduced Ambisonic order.
snd_steamaudio_enable_perspective_correc: Adjusts 3D audio for the listener's perspective.
snd_steamaudio_ir_duration: Sets how long Steam Audio keeps sound reflections after the original sound starts.
snd_steamaudio_reverb_update_rate: Limits how many times per second Steam Audio updates reverb.
sparseshadowtree_cs_exclude_next_cascade: Skips unpacking the inside of a shadow cascade where a higher-resolution cascade already covers it.
sparseshadowtree_parallel_generation: Controls how jobs build sparse shadow tiles. Use 0 to disable parallel jobs, 1 to wait for the batch's pixel readback, or 2 for asynchronous readback.
stats_collect_gpu: Collects GPU counters during stats_display so stats_print_gpu can report them.
sv_debug_overlays_bandwidth: Broadcasts network traffic for the server's debug overlays.
sv_enable_donttransmit: Tells each client which entities exist but are no longer sent, so the client can distinguish them from deletions.
sv_frame_perf_sample_buffer_max: Sets the dedicated server's frame performance sample buffer limit. The client equivalent is cl_frame_perf_sample_buffer_max.
sv_maxupdaterate: Caps the number of updates per second the server allows.
sv_maxvelocity: Caps the speed of ballistically moving objects along each axis.
sv_minupdaterate: Sets the minimum number of updates per second the server allows.
sv_parallel_sendsnapshot: Controls snapshot jobs. Use 0 for the main thread, 1 for async except on dedicated servers, 2 for async, 3 for parallel with completion before the next tick, or 4 for parallel client jobs followed by HLTV jobs.
tv_enable_delta_frames: Stores intermediate spectator TV frames as differences. This uses less memory and more processor time.
vis_enable: Uses precomputed visibility to decide what the player can see.
volume_fog_density_scale: Scales the density of volumetric fog throughout the game.
